strings.zh: 这里是休闲之家{SCROLL}如果需要休息就请进来吧！

strings.zh: 毽子棉『Juuu——plu！
strings.en: Jumpluff: Juuu-plu!

strings.zh: 袋龙『Kaaa——ga！
strings.en: Kangaskhan: Kaaa-ga!

strings.zh: 度假区的位置这么偏,{NEWLINE}我和老头子一路走过来{CLEAR}还真是不容易呢。
strings.en: The Resort Zone is so out of the way.{NEWLINE}It wasn’t easy for my old man and me to{CLEAR}walk all the way here.

strings.zh: 听说这里有情侣双打比赛,{NEWLINE}不知道我们这样的老两口{CLEAR}能不能报名参加呢。
strings.en: I heard there’s a Couples Double Battle{NEWLINE}here. I wonder if an old married pair{CLEAR}like us can enter.

strings.zh: 前面是野生精灵的栖息地,{NEWLINE}为了保护度假区周围的生态,{CLEAR}后面的草丛禁止游客进入。{CLEAR}如果你想捕捉精灵,{CLEAR}请去度假区北面的联动公园。
strings.en: Ahead is a wild Pokémon habitat.{SCROLL}To protect the wildlife around the{NEWLINE}Resort Zone, visitors may not enter the{CLEAR}grass beyond.{SCROLL}If you want to catch Pokémon, please go{NEWLINE}to the Pal Park, north of here.

strings.zh: 度假区的风景这么好,{NEWLINE}将来一定能成为超过月见山{CLEAR}和自然公园的约会圣地！
strings.en: The scenery at the Resort Zone is so{NEWLINE}lovely. It’s sure to become a better{CLEAR}date spot than Mt. Moon or the National{CLEAR}Park someday!

strings.zh: 我为了来度假特地买了新裙子,{NEWLINE}怎么样,跟这里的景色很搭吧？
strings.en: I bought a new dress just for this{NEWLINE}vacation. What do you think? Goes great{CLEAR}with the scenery, right?

strings.zh: 本来想买点度假区特产带回去的,{NEWLINE}可是一看价格都好贵啊……
strings.en: I wanted to buy some Resort Zone{NEWLINE}souvenirs to take home, but one look at{CLEAR}the prices... Yikes.

strings.zh: 度假区餐厅里有各种美味的小吃,{NEWLINE}味道真的不错！
strings.en: The Resort Zone restaurant has all{NEWLINE}sorts of tasty snacks. So good!

strings.zh: 我要是能变成巴大蝴,{NEWLINE}就可以飞往世界各地去旅游了。
strings.en: If I were a Butterfree, I could fly{NEWLINE}around the world on vacation.

strings.zh: 巴大蝴『Buuu——te！
strings.en: Butterfree: Buuu-te!

strings.zh: 在情侣双打比赛中胜出的情侣,{NEWLINE}可以携手走到北面那个{CLEAR}布满鲜花的平台{CLEAR}接收大家的祝福哦。
strings.en: The couple that wins the Couples Double{NEWLINE}Battle gets to walk hand in hand up to{CLEAR}the flower-covered stage to the north{CLEAR}and receive everyone’s blessings!

strings.zh: 为了让我的超能力进一步提升,{NEWLINE}我特地来到这个风水宝地修行。{CLEAR}你如果有时间的话,{CLEAR}陪我来一场修行对战如何？
strings.en: I came to this spot with great feng shui{NEWLINE}to train and push my psychic powers{CLEAR}even further. If you have time, how{CLEAR}about a training battle with me?

strings.en: Resort Zone{SCROLL}Your getaway for rest and relaxation!

strings.zh: 我会认真对待每一次修行,{NEWLINE}请你也认真应战哦。
strings.en: I take every training session seriously.{NEWLINE}Please battle seriously too.

strings.zh: 哎呀,你的意志力好强啊。
strings.en: Oh my, your willpower is so strong.

strings.zh: 双打的话要至少带两只精灵！
strings.en: You need at least two Pokémon for a{NEWLINE}Double Battle!

strings.zh: 这么好一片水,{NEWLINE}里面一定有很多鱼。{CLEAR}可惜堤岸建的有点高,{CLEAR}根本没法甩竿下去。
strings.en: Such a nice stretch of water. There{NEWLINE}must be lots of fish in it. Too bad the{CLEAR}embankment is built so high, I can’t{CLEAR}even cast my line.

strings.zh: 在情侣双打比赛上拿了冠军的话,{NEWLINE}度假区饭店的食物可以免费吃到饱。{CLEAR}为了一家三口的这顿大餐,{CLEAR}我和丈夫一定要在比赛中夺冠！
strings.en: If we win the Couples Double Battle, the{NEWLINE}Resort Zone restaurant lets us eat all{CLEAR}we want for free. For our family of{CLEAR}three’s big feast, my husband and I are{CLEAR}going to win this thing!

strings.zh: 来度假区玩喽！哦哦！
strings.en: We’re at the Resort Zone! Woo-hoo!

strings.zh: 看到这里的火把没,{NEWLINE}那可都是我用喷火之技点燃的。{CLEAR}怎么样,是不是很帅啊？
strings.en: See these torches? I lit every one of{NEWLINE}them with my fire-breathing trick.{CLEAR}Pretty cool, huh?

strings.zh: 欢迎来到度假区！{NEWLINE}前面是我们度假区的游乐场所{CLEAR}——联动公园。{SCROLL}在那里您可以捕捉到{NEWLINE}城都地区几乎遇不到的稀有精灵,{CLEAR}请进去看看吧！
strings.en: Welcome to the Resort Zone! Up ahead is{NEWLINE}our main attraction, the Pal Park.{SCROLL}There you can catch rare Pokémon you{NEWLINE}almost never see in Johto. Please go{CLEAR}take a look!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,我要让儿子好好看看{NEWLINE}我们夫妻在情侣双打比赛中的英姿。
strings.en: Heh heh, I want our son to see how{NEWLINE}awesome his mom and dad look in the{CLEAR}Couples Double Battle.

strings.zh: 好想要芳缘地区的宝贝龙啊,{NEWLINE}你如果有的话{CLEAR}跟我的煤炭龟交换怎么样？
strings.en: I really want a Bagon from Hoenn. If{NEWLINE}you have one, how about trading it for{CLEAR}my Torkoal?

strings.zh: 果然人人都想要宝贝龙。
strings.en: I guess everyone wants a Bagon.

strings.zh: 哈哈,有了宝贝龙,{NEWLINE}我就是同学中最厉害的了！
strings.en: Ha ha! With a Bagon, I’ll be the{NEWLINE}toughest kid in my class!
